summary: Beazer Homes filed an 8-K announcing a conditional notice to redeem all $350.0 million of its outstanding 7.250% Senior Notes due 2029 at 101.208% of principal plus accrued interest, with an October 20, 2026 redemption date. The redemption is conditioned on the substantially concurrent closing of Beazer's previously announced merger into a wholly owned Dream Finders Homes subsidiary under an August 6, 2026 merger agreement. The notice links note repayment directly to merger financing, so the notes become due only if the Merger Condition is satisfied or waived, tying bondholder outcome to deal completion risk.
